title: Error catalog
description: curriculum/catalogs/errors.json: one entry per error category of contracts/turn_analysis.schema.json. Each has a name in both languages, a one-sentence rule, a typical example with its correction, the Indonesian contrast when there is one, and two versions of the explanation: simple (A1 to B1) and full (B2 and above), each in English and Indonesian (docs/CURRICULUM_SPEC.md section 9, ROADMAP C-05). Inferred from those texts; the spec ships no schema.

bilingual.description: English and Indonesian are both required in this catalog.

category.description: A category of contracts/turn_analysis.schema.json. content-cli checks the name against the contract.

indonesian_contrast.description: Where Indonesian works differently and causes this mistake. Written in Indonesian. Absent when there is no useful contrast.
